executive_summary: Rate LYFT Overweight and build exposure in stages rather than chase all at once. Start with a half-size position and add only if LYFT sustains free-cash-flow strength, stable revenue, and improving operating margins while holding the 50-day moving-average/recent-support zone; target a moderate overweight of roughly 1.25x-1.5x normal size over a 3-6 month horizon. If LYFT loses support or the cash-generation thesis weakens after the next earnings report, pause adds and reassess.
